data.name: YouMod
data.subtitle: All-in-one YouTube enhancement tweak
data.localizedDescription: YouMod is a customizable YouTube enhancement tweak by Tonwalter888. It includes ad blocking, background playback, PiP support, UI customization, integrated download manager, and sponsor segment skipping.
data.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.36.6 | YouMod_21.36.6_2.0.0

### Latest Release, ENJOY!!

> [!NOTE]
> - **YTUHD** is not included. 4K is available for A16+ devices.
> - [v2.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/Tonwalter888/YouMod/releases/tag/v2.0.0)
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` `YTweaks`
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino` `VolumeBoostYT` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic`

> [!WARNING]
> - Extra tweaks that are bundled may be unstable on newer versions.

> [!WARNING]
> - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.

compatibility.notes: Official project: Tonwalter888/YouMod. The upstream repo publishes the tweak as a .deb only; this source serves a ready-to-sideload IPA built from the official tweak by mrdrvt99/YouProEXTRA. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time.
